scope: Six-phase Core1B method for MAIN and each instance; distinct Core1A completed teaching

method.known_skill: Y: already taught law and prerequisite
method.route: Z: permissible cue connecting Y to fresh problem
no_claims: No approved Blueprint or adapter was selected

stages.title: Predict
stages.principle: Commit to a justified physical choice before solution reveal
stages.learner_action: State the initial model and why it might work
stages.expected_evidence: Recorded pre-reveal prediction and exposure status
stages.failure: Only a guess or answer already revealed

stages.title: Attempt
stages.principle: Elicit fresh learner-owned inference W with protected first response
stages.learner_action: Choose a one-second flow model and build independent force and power rates
stages.expected_evidence: Immutable first model, saved time, ordered hint and reveal exposure
stages.failure: Copied Core1A or hinted W reported as unassisted

stages.title: Reconstruct
stages.principle: Explain why each model step and physical condition is valid
stages.learner_action: Find the first difference between their model and the full warranted ledger
stages.expected_evidence: Model comparison, accepted and rejected reasoning, independent check
stages.failure: Only final numeric answer or formula

stages.title: Diagnose
stages.principle: Locate misconception from actual answer evidence rather than guess
stages.learner_action: Identify first wrong inference and what condition it violates
stages.expected_evidence: Diagnostic claim supported by saved first response, otherwise UNCERTAIN
stages.failure: A clicked misconception label treated as proven

stages.title: Repair
stages.principle: Rebuild the causal model, not merely the final number
stages.learner_action: Rewrite first wrong physical step and explain replacement with Core1A reason
stages.expected_evidence: Separate repaired inference and physical check
stages.failure: Overwrite original or change answer without reason

stages.title: Boundary test / Edge case
stages.principle: Verify transfer after changing a governing condition
stages.learner_action: Recalculate with a slower belt, changed flow rate and incoming speed kept fixed
stages.expected_evidence: Protected new model, check, and identified changed condition
stages.failure: Only cosmetic number change or solution shown in advance
